scripts.build: node scripts/gen-mobile.mjs && node scripts/gen-species.mjs && vite build
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build:app && cap sync ios
scripts.ios:open: npm run build:app && cap sync ios && cap open ios
scripts.ios:archive: npm run build:app && cap sync ios && xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -allowProvisioningUpdates $(sh scripts/xc-auth.sh) -archivePath "$HOME/Library/Developer/Xcode/Archives/$(date +%Y-%m-%d)/Reef Bloom $(date +%Y-%m-%d-%H.%M).xcarchive" archive
scripts.mac:archive: npm run build:app && cap sync ios && xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=macOS,variant=Mac Catalyst' -allowProvisioningUpdates $(sh scripts/xc-auth.sh) -archivePath "$HOME/Library/Developer/Xcode/Archives/$(date +%Y-%m-%d)/Reef Bloom Mac $(date +%Y-%m-%d-%H.%M).xcarchive" archive
scripts.mac:run: npm run build:app && cap sync ios && xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Debug -destination 'generic/platform=macOS,variant=Mac Catalyst' -derivedDataPath build/mac CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build && codesign --force --deep --sign - --entitlements ios/App/App/Mac.entitlements build/mac/Build/Products/Debug-maccatalyst/App.app && open -n build/mac/Build/Products/Debug-maccatalyst/App.app
